These are prior estimates, not checked against the NAS-Bench-201 table. Interaction effects that hold consistently across all three datasets with a meaningful margin are uncommon, so most claims get low numbers. I gave somewhat higher numbers to the edit-equals-condition cases (0, 29), where the edit's effect depends directly on what the edge currently holds.
